senses.gloss: --a Mt. to the east of अरुणोद. वा. ३६. १८.
--a वानर chief. Br. III. 7. २३३.
--a daughter of नील, wife of विरूपक, the नैरृत Ra1ks2asa: mother of भूमिराक्षसस्, ugly in shape; bald headed and slow to move. Br. III. 7. २३२ and २३८.
(I)--a वानर chief. Br. III. 7. २३२ and २३८.
(II)--a commander of भण्ड. Br. IV. २१. ७८.
--a brother of बलाहक and a commander of भण्ड. Br. IV. २१. ७८; २४. 9 and ५०.
--a follower of शिव. Br. III. ४१. २६.
--a राक्षस killed in the लन्का war. भा. IX. १०. १८.
(I)--an ally of युधिष्ठिर: took active part in his राजसूय. भा. X. ७५. 6. [page३-213+ २९]
(II)--a brother of बलाहक and a commander of भण्ड: भेरुण्ड was his riding animal. Br. IV. २४. 9 and ४९.
(III)--the first of the two sons of खशा (s.v.); the most terrible and terror striking; with four hands, four feet and two ways of moving, etc. वा. ६९. ७६-79.
--derivatives from प्रकृति of which there are sixteen (eleven organs and five elements): साङ्ख्य philosophy. M. 3. १७; वा. १०२. ११३; १०४. ९९.
--a ritual of the श्राद्ध. वा. ७६. ४२.
--a R. of the केतुमाला country. वा. ४४. १७.

--the eldest of the १०० sons of इक्ष्वाकु; Asked by his father to secure some माम्स for his अष्टक ritual, he went to the forest, secured some by killing a thousand animals, and feeling hungry, he ate of a portion of the hare's flesh. When this was found out the father abandoned him. He wandered about the land as शशाद. But on his father's demise, he was enthroned at अयोध्या and came to be known as शशाद. He pleased Hari by sacrifices. Father of Puramjaya:
1: भा. IX. 6. 6-१२; वा. 1. १४१; ८८. 9-२०; ८९. 1. Vi. IV. 2. १२-20.
Father of ५०० [page३-214+ २९] sons beginning with शकुनि: Brother of Nimi: went to hell;
2: Br. III. ६३. 9-२३; ६४. 1.
had १५ sons who were kings of countries north of Meru and १४८ others ruling south of it; the eldest of the latter was Kakustha.
3: M. १२. २६-8.
--a name of Hari. भा. III. १६. 6.

--the mother of the gods called the वैकुण्- ठस्;
1: Br. III. 4. ३१.
mother of वैकुण्ठ, the great god in the चाक्षुष
2: Vi. III. 1. ४१.
epoch.
--वृषबेत्ता, Jaya, भीम, शुचि, दान्त, यश, Dama, नाथ, विद्वान्, Ajeya, कृश, Gaura and Dhruva. वा. ६२. ५०.
--the wife of शुभ्र. भा. VIII. 5. 4.
--a place sacred to भद्रसुन्दरी. M. १३. ३६.
--a son of पौरुषेय Ra1ks2asa. Br. III. 7. ९३.
--a son of जीमूत, and father of भीमरथ. भा. IX. २४. 4; Br. III. ७०. ४२; वा. ९५. ४१. Vi. IV. १२. ४१.
--a son of Damana, an अवतार् of the Lord in the third द्वापर. वा. २३. १२४. [page३-215+ २५]
--the mother of the planet अङ्गारक and the wife of Agni (शर्व-वा। प्।). Br. II. १०. ७८; २४. ९१; वा. २७. ५१; Vi. I. 8. 8.
--a god of the ten branches of the सुकर्माण group of devas. Br. IV. 1. ८८; वा. १००. ९३.
--a भागवत; ruled for three years. वा. ९९. ३४१.

(I)--a प्रजापति;
1: Br. III. 1. ५३. वा. ६५. ५३.
famous for originating the वालेय Gandharvas.
2: Ib. ६९. १८.
(II)--a son of Dama: a king who increased the welfare of his kingdom; father of सुधृति. वा. ८६. १३.
(III)--a son of Bheda. वा. ९९. १९६.
(IV)--(Satyahita): a son of पुष्पवान्. वा. ९९. २२४.
--one of the विद्याधर gan2as. वा. ६९. २९.
--a दानव. Br. III. 6. 6.
--one of Danu's sons. वा. ६८. 6. [page३-216+ २६]
